writeup.headline: S&P +0.2% at Lunch; Technology Leads
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Nvidia Falls 8.5% on Reports Board May Oust Huang. The AI names are up and the average stock is down: the AI giants are leading while the rest of the market lags. Cyclical sectors are leading defensive ones, and the S&P has held its gains all session.
